title: FinRobot Experiment Manifest
description: Reproducibility manifest for one backtest or batch audit run. Enables re-running with identical parameters and detecting data drift. Planned for PR3+.

experiment_id.description: Human-readable slug, e.g. 'nvda-tsla-jun2025-baseline'. Unique per run.

description.description: One-line description of what this experiment is testing.

cutoff_dates.description: Data cutoff dates used. For backtests: one per pass. No forward data beyond each cutoff.

phases.description: Pipeline phases executed in this experiment.

model_name.description: LLM used, e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6'. Null for regex-only runs.

prompt_versions.description: Map of phase to prompt version used, e.g. {'claim_extraction': 'claim_extractor_v1'}.

fallback_used.description: True if Ollama fallback was triggered. Affects result comparability.

known_limitations.description: Explicit limitations for this run, e.g. 'period_attribution_bug_unfixed', 'sample_n_equals_9'.

git_sha.description: Git commit SHA at time of run for reproducibility.
